concept: Some Couples Come With Private Captions
creator_direction: Pick the old Friends-reference/private-caption session and create the final illustration carousel from it. Use different locations and dresses to show different moments because this should feel like a story of every two people in love.
keep_from_old_session: one person is seen more kindly by the person who loves them
light context, no side notes, no arrows, no label clutter
reject_from_old_session: Friends actors, Friends frames, sitcom sets, couch-lineup visual language
soft tableaux where labels carry the whole joke
local overlay as the default final strategy
same outfit and setting across the whole deck
generic warm couple scenes with no concrete behavior receipt
fresh_reset_decision: Build an 8-slide package with a hook, six varied behavior receipts, and an earned universal ending.
